## Toast.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `tone` :: The meaning of the toast. `danger` and `warning` are announced assertively; the rest politely.
- `loading` :: Shows a spinner in place of the tone icon. The imperative `toast.loading()` also keeps the toast until it is updated.
- `surface` :: The surface behind the card: fill, border, rim and shadow. Defaults to `glass`.
- `shape` :: The corner shape.
- `pad` :: The inset around the icon, the message and the actions.
- `gap` :: The space between the icon, the message and the close button.
- `measure` :: The width of the card on the measure ladder.
- `textSize` :: Text scale of the message.
- `childTextSize` :: Text scale of the description. Falls back to `textSize`.
- `childTextColor` :: Ink of the description. Defaults to `text-secondary`.
- `message` :: The main message. Used when `children` is omitted.
- `description` :: Supporting text under the message.
- `action` :: A button for the next step. The toast is dismissed after it is pressed.
- `cancel` :: A quieter button that dismisses the toast.
- `actionProps` :: Props passed on to the action button — variant, size, icon or anything else `Button` takes. Spread after the toast's own defaults, so it wins.
- `cancelProps` :: Props passed on to the cancel button, with the same reach.
- `dismissible` :: Shows a close button.
- `iconSize` :: Text scale of the status icon and of the close button.
- `onDismiss` :: Called when the toast is dismissed by the close button, cancel, or the action.
- `children` :: The message, as a snippet. Replaces `message` when provided.

## Toaster.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `position` :: Where the pile sits in the viewport.
- `max` :: The number of toasts shown at once. Older ones wait until a slot is free.
- `duration` :: Default auto-dismiss time, in milliseconds. `0` keeps toasts until they are dismissed. Overridden per toast.
- `expand` :: When true, the pile stays expanded. When false, it stacks and expands on hover or focus.
- `measure` :: The width of the pile on the measure ladder.

## toast.svelte.ts

Imperative toast API and the reactive list the Toaster host reads.

### `interface ToastAction`

A button shown on a toast — a next step, or a quieter cancel.

- `label` :: The button label.
- `onClick` :: Called when the button is pressed. The toast is then dismissed.
- `href` :: If set, the button is rendered as a link.

### `interface ToastOptions`

Options for `toast()` and its helpers. Passing an existing `id` updates that toast in place.

- `id` :: An explicit id. Reusing one updates the existing toast instead of adding another.
- `tone` :: The tone of the toast. Defaults to `neutral`.
- `loading` :: Shows the spinner state; the toast stays until it is updated or dismissed.
- `description` :: Supporting text under the message.
- `duration` :: Auto-dismiss time in milliseconds. `0` keeps the toast until it is dismissed.
- `action` :: A button for the next step.
- `cancel` :: A quieter button that dismisses the toast.

### `interface ToastItem`

- `tone` :: The tone of this toast.
- `loading` :: Whether this toast is in the loading state.

### `type ToastPromiseMessage`

A message passed to `toast.promise`, either a string, options, or a function of the resolved value.

### `interface ToastPromiseMessages`

- `loading` :: Shown while the promise is pending.
- `success` :: Shown when the promise resolves. May be a function of the resolved value.
- `error` :: Shown when the promise rejects. May be a function of the rejected value.

### `const toaster`

The live list of toasts. The Toaster host reads this; application code uses `toast()`.

### `const toast`

Add, update or dismiss toasts. A `<Toaster />` must be mounted to show them.

### `function claimToaster`

Claim the single Toaster slot. The first mounted host wins; the rest stay idle.
